subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI-warning pieces are bounded, but the requested endpoint and 200/503 semantics affect operator-facing deployment contracts on an M4 Gateway surface.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new HTTP component route.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement /health/cron with explicit cron-only health semantics and accept a new public operator contract.

options.title: Defer Endpoint Semantics
options.body: Ship local logging and cron-list warnings first, leaving endpoint semantics for a later owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new HTTP component route.

likelyOwner.reason: He left the most detailed review context and has recent cross-cutting cron/CLI work around this issue.
